title: mcanvas canvas file
description: A free-form canvas of Typst-rendered blocks, images, and tables. Inspired by Obsidian JSON Canvas but not compatible with it. Source of truth for the Rust side is src/doc.rs and src/table.rs; keep them in sync.

version.description: File format version. Currently 1. Version 0 files kept one canvas in top-level `view` and `nodes`; they are still read, as a single page, and are saved as version 1.

grid.description: Snap grid size in canvas units. 0 or negative disables snapping. Defaults to 8 when omitted.

preamble.description: Typst source prepended to every node before compiling (fonts, colors, #let helpers). Defaults to empty.

page.description: Id of the page shown when the file is opened. Omitted or unknown means the first page.

pages.description: Pages (tabs), in tab order. Each has its own nodes and viewport; `grid` and `preamble` are shared. When empty or omitted the app starts with one empty page.

view.description: Version 0 only: viewport of the single canvas. Read into the first page; never written.

nodes.description: Version 0 only: nodes of the single canvas. Read as a page placed before `pages`; never written.

id.description: Short random identifier, unique among pages. Same format as node ids.

view.description: Saved viewport for this page. Defaults to origin at zoom 1 when omitted.

nodes.description: Blocks on this page. Node ids are unique across the whole file, not just the page. Defaults to empty.

arrows.description: Directed connections between nodes on this page.

x.description: Canvas x coordinate at the left edge of the window.

y.description: Canvas y coordinate at the top edge of the window.

id.description: Short random identifier, unique within the file. The app generates 8 lowercase hex characters, but any non-empty string is accepted.

type.description: Node kind. "typst" renders `source`; "image" displays the embedded `data` or the file at `src`; "table" renders `table` as a Typst table.

height.description: Height in canvas units. null or omitted means auto: derived from the Typst render or the image aspect ratio. A number means the user resized it.

source.description: Typst source for a "typst" node. Omitted when empty.

src.description: Image path for an "image" node, absolute or relative to the canvas file's directory.

data.description: Embedded image for an "image" node, as base64-encoded PNG. Pasted images are stored this way. Takes precedence over `src`.

expr.description: A Typst expression copied verbatim into the generated code, e.g. "0.5pt + gray", "center + horizon", "none". A bare hex color such as "#dbeafe" is wrapped as rgb("#dbeafe").

oneOrMany.description: A single expression, or one per column like Typst's `align: (left, right)`.

track.description: Typst track size: "auto", a fraction like "1fr", or a length like "80pt".

cell.description: One cell. A plain string is Typst markup for the body. An object maps to table.cell(..)[body].

line.description: A table.hline (in `hlines`, `at` is y) or table.vline (in `vlines`, `at` is x).

table.description: Mirrors Typst's table() so compilation is lossless. Cells are emitted in order and placed automatically, left to right then top to bottom, skipping slots covered by a span. Each inner array of `cells` starts a new grid row.

columns.description: Column track sizes -> `columns:`. Empty means one auto column per cell in the widest row.

rows.description: Row track sizes -> `rows:`. Empty means auto.

header.description: Number of leading rows wrapped in table.header(..).

footer.description: Number of trailing rows wrapped in table.footer(..).

bold_header.description: Emit a show rule that renders header rows in bold.

cells.description: Rows of cells in emission order.

trunk.description: Saved manual linking intent. Matching ids identify linked arrows on this page. Geometry is recomputed; infeasible groups pause without discarding intent.

coordinate.description: Shared x for vertical segments, y for horizontal segments.

start.description: Lower coordinate along the shared segment.

end.description: Upper coordinate along the shared segment; must exceed start.

trunk.description: Initial selected segment and shared group identity. The initial coordinates are retained for file compatibility; current shared geometry may move.
